1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.type = 'square';
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
21:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:     osc.start();
23:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
24:   }
25:   function playLaserSound() { playTone(600, 0.1); }
26:   function playExplosionSound() { playTone(150, 0.2); }
27:   function playGameOverSound() { playTone(80, 0.5); }
28: 
29:   // Ship definition (triangle)
30:   const ship = {
31:     w: 60,
32:     h: 20,
33:     x: width / 2 - 30,
34:     y: height - 30,
35:     speed: 5,
36:     // Use a gradient for nicer look
37:     color: null
38:   };
39: 
40:   // Laser (single bullet at a time)
41:   const laser = {
42:     active: false,
43:     x: 0,
44:     y: 0,
45:     w: 4,
46:     h: 12,
47:     speed: 8,
48:     color: '#f00'
49:   };
50: 
51:   // Asteroid collection
52:   const asteroids = [];
53:   // Star field for background
54:   const stars = [];
55:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
56:     stars.push({
57:       x: Math.random() * width,
58:       y: Math.random() * height,
59:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
60:     });
61:   }
62:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
63:   let lastSpawn = 0;
64:   const asteroidSpeedBase = 1.5;
65:   const asteroidSpeedIncrement = 0.0005; // per ms
66: 
67:   let score = 0;
68:   let gameOver = false;
69: 
70:   // Input handling
71:   const keys = {};
72:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { audioCtx.resume(); keys[e.code] = true; if (e.code === 'Space') fireLaser(); });
73:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
74: 
75:   function fireLaser() {
76:     if (!laser.active) {
77:       laser.active = true;
78:       laser.x = ship.x + ship.w / 2 - laser.w / 2;
79:       laser.y = ship.y;
80:       playLaserSound();
81:     }
82:   }
83: 
84:   function spawnAsteroid() {
85:     const radius = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
86:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
87:     asteroids.push({
88:       x,
89:       y: -radius,
90:       r: radius,
91:       speed: asteroidSpeedBase + Math.random() * 1.5,
92:       angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
93:       angularSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02 // rotate slowly
94:     });
95:   }
96: 
97:   function update(delta) {
98:     if (gameOver) return;
99:     // Move ship
100:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
101:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) ship.x += ship.speed;
102:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
103: 
104:     // Update laser
105:     if (laser.active) {
106:       laser.y -= laser.speed;
107:       if (laser.y + laser.h < 0) laser.active = false;
108:     }
109: 
110:     // Spawn asteroids over time
111:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
112:       spawnAsteroid();
113:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
114:     }
115: 
116:     // Update asteroids
117:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
118:       const a = asteroids[i];
119:       a.y += a.speed + asteroidSpeedIncrement * performance.now();
120:       // Collision with ship
121:       if (
122:         a.x + a.r > ship.x &&
123:         a.x - a.r < ship.x + ship.w &&
124:         a.y + a.r > ship.y &&
125:         a.y - a.r < ship.y + ship.h
126:       ) {
127:           gameOver = true;
128:           playGameOverSound();
129:           }
130: 
131:       }
132:       // Remove if off screen
133:       if (a.y - a.r > height) {
134:         gameOver = true;
135:       }
136:     }
137:   }
138: 
139:   function draw() {
140:     // Background gradient
141:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
142:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
143:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
144:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
145:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
146: 
147:     // Star field
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:     stars.forEach(s => {
150:       ctx.beginPath();
151:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     });
154: 
155:     // Ship as triangle with gradient
156:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
157:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00f');
158:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#88f');
159:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
160:     ctx.beginPath();
161:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
162:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
163:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
164:     ctx.closePath();
165:     ctx.fill();
166: 
167:     // Laser with glow
168:     if (laser.active) {
169:       ctx.save();
170:       ctx.shadowColor = 'red';
171:       ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
172:       ctx.fillStyle = laser.color;
173:       ctx.fillRect(laser.x, laser.y, laser.w, laser.h);
174:       ctx.restore();
175:     }
176: 
177:     // Asteroids with radial gradient
178:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555'; // fallback
179:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
180:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
181:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#888');
182:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
183:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
184:       ctx.beginPath();
185:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
186:       ctx.fill();
187:     });
188: 
189:     // Score
190:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
191:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
192:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
193: 
194:     // Game over overlay
195:     if (gameOver) {
196:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
197:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
198:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
199:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
200:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
201:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
202:     }
203:   }
204: 
205:   let lastTime = 0;
206:   function loop(timestamp) {
207:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
208:     lastTime = timestamp;
209:     update(delta);
210:     draw();
211:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
212:   }
213:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
214: })();

(End of file - total 214 lines)
